Phase 2 reader must verify the right column reads completely. UNIQUE STRUCTURE: continuous prose with NO internal section headings — Pöggeler produces a single sustained argument; do not impose artificial section breaks in the analysis. The essay closes the volume with a thesis directly opposed to Gross's titular opening claim ('rhetorical ontology' vs. 'restricted conception of rhetoric'). Pöggeler's prior 11 pieces are cited in the Bibliography; he is the volume's most prolific contributor by self-citation. The argument moves backward from 1947 → 1957 → Marburg, with topology-of-being supplanting rhetoric as Heidegger's mature philosophical concept.
